sentences.text: Shri Ajit Rawat - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.

Order 
This is the sixth bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. (New Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023) on behalf of applicant for grant of temporary bail relating to FIR No.176/2018, registered at Police Station Dehat, District Chhindwara (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420/34, 409 of Indian Penal Code.
Prayer is also made for release of applicant on temporary bail as he is suffering from serious illness.
2. During course of argument, counsel for applicant submitted that considering long period of incarceration and fact that applicant is suffering from fatal disease.
Applicant is also suffering from fluting of stomach, Sugar, BP.
It is also argued that pleural effusions may be due to cancerous cell.
Applicant will not be able to get proper treatment in jail, therefore, applicant may be released on regular bail under Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:40407 2 MCRC-21361-2024 3.
Learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the bail application and submitted that report has been received from Superintendent of Jail.
On going through the report, it is found that there is pleural effusion in lungs.
Applicant is under regular treatment in jail at Chhindwara and also at Jabalpur.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

5. Considering the report which has been submitted by Superintendent of Jail, it is found that applicant is suffering from serious health complications which may prove to be fatal for him if he is allowed to remain in jail for some more time.
Applicant is already in jail for more than three years.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that applicant shall be released on regular bail on furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with two local solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
